---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a console, image format, recording backend or workflow improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

## Requested feature

Describe the console, image format, hardware support or workflow you would like Retro Burner to add.

## Why it belongs in Retro Burner

What separate program/manual process do users currently need, and how would this fit the one-for-all disc workflow?

## Example images / formats

List common image extensions/layouts (for example BIN/CUE, ISO, CHD) and any known special requirements. Do not upload copyrighted game data.

## Hardware / validation

If the request needs unusual media, a specific burner or real-console testing, describe what is known and what hardware would be required.

## Open-source references

If an existing open-source project implements part of the workflow, link it and identify its licence if known. Retro Burner will not copy/integrate code until provenance and licence compatibility are checked.
